verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an in-product AI agent that can analyze your workspace. It can also run scheduled analytical tasks such as deliverability reports, segment audits and broadcast recaps. Separately, it builds segments from plain-text descriptions via "Describe segment". missing for 10: explicit documentation of proactive suggestions or recommendations derived from data, detail on the depth and format of insights shown in the product UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
